metadata.title: Login fails with NullPointerException in LoginService
metadata.actual_root_cause: The session object was not initialized before LoginService.validateUser() read it — a race condition on first login after a service restart.
metadata.actual_fix: Added a null check with a clear error before use, and fixed session initialization order in LoginService so the session object is guaranteed to exist before validateUser() runs.
metadata.resolution_notes: Verified with load test simulating cold-start logins.

metadata.title: MySQL connection refused under peak load
Submit button unresponsive on Safari mobile
metadata.actual_root_cause: A CSS pointer-events rule was unintentionally applied to the button's parent element on narrow viewports, which Safari treats differently.
metadata.actual_fix: Removed the conflicting rule and added a mobile-specific test.
